adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` defines keys using computed property names like `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. Those expressions evaluate to a *string literal* (the `toString()` representation of a Zod schema), not a wildcard/dynamic key matcher. As written, the schema will only validate objects containing those exact literal property names, so it will incorrectly reject/accept real token payloads. This is a concrete correctness defect visible in the diff. The note about missing unit tests is also consistent with the diff (no tests added), but the schema issue alone qualifies as a bug.
